_note: GENERIC EXAMPLE -- NOT real canon. The method=reference TWIN of char:ashen-reaver: same atoms, same plate, same weight, same scope, differing ONLY in identity_ref.method. Run it with `pcraft recipe --contract char:ashen-reaver-cloud`; the SDXL pair (char:ashen-reaver) stays the example for `pcraft synth/gate/bind` and is not retargeted. WHY IT EXTENDS THE CLOUD FACTION AND NOT THE SDXL ONE: reference_lock.assemble refuses the whole merged identity lock if ANY plate on it declares an SDXL-family method, and loader._merge_identity_refs puts the inherited faction plate first -- so extending faction:ashen-pact would refuse on the inherited ip_adapter costume plate no matter what this file declares. Overriding that inherited plate is not an option either: _merge_identity_refs refuses a same-plate method rewrite as CONTRACT_RELAXATION. Hence a separate id PAIR, never an override. Its must_not atoms are `optional`: absence-verification is not yet measured on this stack, so these checks run and report but do not block a bind. Raise them to `required` when the verifier is calibrated for absence.
